title: "R: Respiratory system"
description: "ATC group R for modelers: the level 2 map with example drugs, and the inhaled-route modeling notes held at R03."
date: "2026-02-08"
---

Drugs acting on the airways, centered on R03 for obstructive airway disease.
The interesting part for a modeler is the inhaled route, where the target tissue is also the site of administration [@borghardt2018pulmkinetics; @daleyyates2015ics].
Those modeling notes live with [R03, drugs for obstructive airway diseases](r03/).

In April 1955 Susie Maison asked her father George, president of Riker Laboratories, why her asthma medicine could not come in a spray can like hairspray.
The first pressurized metered dose inhalers were approved on 9 March 1956 [@steinHistoryTherapeuticAerosols2017].

|  | Description | In plain terms | Example drug |
| ---: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **R01** | Nasal preparations |  | Mometasone (R01AD09) / fluticasone furoate (R01AD12), intranasal corticosteroids for allergic rhinitis; xylometazoline (R01AA07) for short-term decongestion |
| **R02** | Throat preparations |  | Symptomatic relief only. Benzydamine (R02AX03) is the best-supported topical analgesic, chlorhexidine (R02AA05) the common antiseptic lozenge |
| [**R03**](r03/) | Drugs for obstructive airway diseases | asthma and COPD inhalers | Budesonide with formoterol (R03AK07, listed as "formoterol and budesonide") / salbutamol (R03AC02) |
| **R05** | Cough and cold preparations |  | No strongly evidenced agent; acetylcysteine (R05CB01) and dextromethorphan (R05DA09) are the most used. Dornase alfa (R05CB13) is a genuine standard, but only in cystic fibrosis |
| **R06** | Antihistamines for systemic use |  | Cetirizine (R06AE07) / loratadine (R06AX13) |
| **R07** | Other respiratory system products | leftovers: surfactants, cystic-fibrosis drugs, nitric oxide | Ivacaftor, tezacaftor and elexacaftor (R07AX32) for cystic fibrosis; neonatal surfactant sits under natural phospholipids (R07AA02), which covers poractant alfa and beractant with no substance-specific code |
